analysis (B9.9): frequency, measured response, feedback and Nyquist, root locus,
Routh, pole-zero, lead/lag, initial state, state structure, relative gain;
opened recordings: archive reading, channel catalogue, independent pairs;
validation rules: plan, scenarios, campaign, run assessment (N8),
model check, plant decision, isolated-run records; Validate section;
commissioning rules (B6, A6, C0, C1): starting point, Auto-entry allowance,
transfer records and checks (E6), parameter transactions (E7), initialization,
observation, the one Restore from the checkpoint, Keep's edits; Apply section;
setup rules (B1): compiled catalog, form model, generators, save;
failures with next actions (A11); json: every decode with normalized numbers

g.data-qualified-name: Rust engine. process trust-control-studio .checklist rust-logic-migration.md. V0 foundation. V1 Identify. V2 Tune. V3 Validate. V4 Apply.Restore.Keep. V5 setup. serves the panel from V6..rust_commands
g.text: serve: JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout, Content-Length frames
command line (§0.1b): open, identify, tune, validate, apply, restore, keep, setup, cancel;
token never an argument; apply/restore/keep: review, then --review <identity>
methods controlStudio/open | status | cancel | page | inputs | run | identify | tune | preview |
validate | apply | restore | keep | setupDiscover | setupSave | analyze
analyze: the Tune page's tools for every loop, quick or as operations;
identify importRecording / importModel / openRecording: opened files and supplied models
Identify workflow: campaign driver, reconciliation, recovery
Tune: Automatic, SIMC, AMIGO, relay rule, manual settings;
designs from the study model, never writes to the controller;
the relay rule reads its recording; preview stores nothing
Validate: live model check (provisional model), then isolated
actual-ST runs of current and candidate per scenario (E8.4), journaled
Apply: starting point wait, Manual staging, parameters, Auto entry, observed
target change; a failure after the first write runs the one Restore
Identify: enters and returns the mode its method needs (A6.2)
long operations: operationId at once, controlStudio/update

g.text: truST folder in the user's local state folder, one file per loop,
shared by serve and the command line
commissioning checkpoint, Identify mode change, isolated jobs
journaled before dispatch; never a token
identification and tuning of the TypeScript session
existing start, cancellation and close ownership
configured plant or explicit prediction override
runs at the loop task's executions; observes each
scan once; writes apply at the next task boundary
Identification stops on its model for review.
Tabs only navigate; Tune starts on request and stops at its candidate.\n Validate starts the independent model check and controller campaign.
Reset clears the working model, results and chart history.
Live selected-signal observation continues after Reset/reopen.
The chart grows from current plant readings during acquisition.
Model comparisons retain the matching experiment inputs.
All pages display the same host-owned study.
A loop the engine serves runs Identify, Tune, Validate, Apply, Restore
and Keep in trust-control-studio; the TypeScript session keeps parked
loops and the features the engine does not serve yet (V7).
A declared coherent multivariable adapter uses its complete binding.
Separate PID instances are never updated by an invented sequential group write.
Closing the panel detaches this client only. A running identification
experiment and its recording stay with the runtime; the campaign journal
stays in workspace state; reopening reattaches and completes the campaign.
A client that still owns its experiment aborts it only on an explicit
Cancel or after a failure, through the restoration path.
Closing during an Apply's observation detaches it the same way: the runtime
keeps recording the response, and reopening reattaches at once, assesses it
and reports the Apply's journalled transfers with the target change.
An Apply interrupted before its observation began is recovered by reviewed
recovery: the runtime recording is stopped, its samples are kept in the
checkpoint and the runtime buffer is released.
A legacy study copy in workspace state moves into the project on open.
Removed from Control Studio: Manual Record, model-based validation
matched anti-windup comparison (no panel entry point).
native response context menu / recording export
current raw recording or immutable opened history
new operation resets live chart once
restore method, selected signals and retained trace
require model pass; freeze controller scenarios
prepare bytecode, then bounded actual-ST scans
writes at the loop task's executions
